description: Off-by-default memory knobs in the TF model and runtime (R2, design sections 3.1-3.9): width presets and positivity validation, --gradient-checkpointing full with BN moving statistics updated exactly once per step, the lean trilinear sampler (bit-identical forward, sequenced dy-guarded custom backward), lean losses, split group-mean conv, the CLI/TrainConfig/Trainer/main.py wiring (incl. _build_n), and the T=6 vs T=7 accuracy test/verdict. Plan items 1-8. First feature; FEAT-002 needs models/width_presets.count_params from it.
steps: Plan item 1: create TF-free models/width_presets.py (PRESETS table of design 3.1 exactly, uniform(m) = max(8, 8*floor(w*m/8+0.5)), preset_args, preset_kwargs, count_params returning per-part counts encoder/linear_decoder/deform_decoder/total; unknown name -> ValueError listing names; docstring notes explicit 'default' decoder widths != ModelConfig() None). Add positivity checks to ModelConfig.validate (filters/reductions/dense entries int >= 1, ValueError naming the field) and parser.error checks in runtime/args.py parse_args for --filters (6 entries), --reductions, --dense. Tests: tests/test_width_presets.py (no TF) and tests/test_width_presets_tf.py (tests.tf_setup first; count_params within 1% of built level-4 trainable count for every preset; default 29.63 M, f0d1 29.54 M).
Plan item 2: move smooth_field from tests/test_diffeo.py to new tests/field_helpers.py unchanged; test_diffeo imports it.

Plan item 3: new models/checkpointing.py recompute(fn, bn_layers=()) per design 3.2 (call 1 = forward; every later call snapshots moving_mean/moving_variance of BatchNormWithSeparateAffine.bn, runs fn, restores under control_dependencies on outputs; no ops when training is Python False/None or all stats_frozen). Add layers.batch_norm_layers(layer) and make runtime/run.py Trainer._bn_layers delegate to it. models/group_net.py: GRADIENT_CHECKPOINTING += 'full'; _call_deform under 'full' with encoder.built and deform_decoder.built: recompute(encoder skips, encoder_bn), recompute(decoder, decoder_bn), two separate tf.recompute_grad integrate_svf blocks for v and -v; else today's direct path; linear tasks unchanged. runtime/args.py: choices += full; full without deform -> parser.error("--gradient-checkpointing full needs 'deform' in --task-ratio"). Keep none/integrator/decoder/both (incl. their documented double BN update) unchanged; update docstrings. New tests/test_checkpointing.py cases (a) grads full vs none <= 1e-4 rel fp32 and AMP (level 4 narrow N 3), (b) BN stats after one full step == none step (<= 1e-7 rel) and both still double-updates, (b') persistent tape two gradient calls -> one update, (c) frozen stats unchanged, (d) recalibrate_bn under full one update per layer and batch (pattern from tests/test_cascade.py T7), (e) one trace per task over 6 steps rigid:1,affine:1,deform:2, (f) build_model under full creates the same variables as none.

Plan item 4: lean sampler in models/layers.py per design 3.3: sample_voxel_coords(..., lean=False, lean_images_grad=True); lean=False path untouched; lean=True linear -> _sample_linear_lean (tf.custom_gradient; forward = today's float op order with int64 index math, captures only images/coords) with module-level _lean_linear_backward(images, coords, dy, fill_value, boundary, images_grad): module constant _DY_DEP=True dy-dependent zero added to coords only, _axis_terms once, 8 corners in forward order each under tf.control_dependencies on the previous corner's accumulators (d_coords, d_flat only if images_grad), fill/border corrections, images grad None when images_grad False; nearest ignores lean. Code comment states int64 rationale (plan NIT N2). Plumb lean=False through diffeo.warp (+lean_images_grad=True), warp_field, compose, integrate_svf, exp_and_inverse, pairwise_displacement, compose_cascade; GroupRegLevelModel(..., lean_sampler=False) ctor attribute passed to the integrator in all modes. New tests/test_lean_sampler.py: forward max|diff| 0 eager (zero/border, fill 0/0.3, C 1/3/19, fp32/fp64) and inside tf.function under _GrapplerOff (tests/test_cascade.py) + _OpDeterminism (tests/test_trainer.py); gradients <= 1e-4 rel (fp64 <= 1e-12); lean_images_grad=False -> None images grad and identical d coords; exp_and_inverse lean vs default; test_graph_mode_memory cases A (<= 2.25 GiB), B (lean <= 1.24 GiB and default-lean >= 0.85 GiB), C1 (<= 0.58 GiB), C2 (<= 0.41 GiB) with modelled values computed from design 2.1 formulas and printed; case B without _DY_DEP printed only; skip without GPU. If case C fails -> switch to the tf.while_loop(parallel_iterations=1) fallback of design 3.3 and record it in findings. If case A or B fails -> STOP and send_message warning with the numbers.

Plan item 5: runtime/losses.py lean losses per design 3.4: _soft_dice_lean (implicit broadcast, no slices); deform_loss(..., lean_sampler=False, lean_losses=False), pair_dice_loss(..., lean_sampler=False, lean_losses=False), template_ncc_loss/pair_ncc_loss(..., lean_sampler=False, lean=False) with local_ncc under tf.recompute_grad when lean; data-volume warps pass lean=lean_sampler, lean_images_grad=False. Defaults keep today's ops exactly. New tests/test_lean_losses.py (losses <= 1e-6 rel, grads <= 1e-4 rel, default bit-identical, combined with lean_sampler on/off).

Plan item 6: split group conv per design 3.5: GroupConvBlock.split_group=False Python attr; True + group + conv.built -> norm->act->conv3d(x,k[...,:C,:])+conv3d(mean,k[...,C:,:]) + bias (compute dtype, layer strides, SAME, NDHWC). layers.set_split_group_conv(layer, on) only on GroupConvBlocks with group=True and pre_activation=True (stem excluded). GroupRegLevelModel(..., split_group_conv=False) calls it; FrozenStage keeps False. New tests/test_split_group_conv.py (outputs <= 1e-6 rel fp32 / 1e-3 fp16, grads <= 1e-4 rel, default bit-identical, variable names/count unchanged, stem split_group False, copy_weights_from split<->non-split, strided blocks).

Plan item 7: wiring per design 3.8: runtime/args.py --lean-sampler, --lean-losses, --split-group-conv (str2bool, default false; lean flags need deform -> parser.error naming the option); TrainConfig lean_sampler/lean_losses (default False) filled in train_config_from_args; Trainer.__init__ ValueError('lean_sampler: model %s vs TrainConfig %s') on mismatch; _make_deform_step passes lean to compose_cascade and lean_sampler/lean_losses to deform_loss; validation paths keep defaults. main.py: pass lean_sampler/split_group_conv to GroupRegLevelModel; factor _build_n(args) (today's rule, then min(n_build, 2) when split_group_conv). Update docstrings. Tests in tests/test_main.py / tests/test_runtime_infra.py: invalid values of every new flag, _build_n (split group 16/deform 8 -> 2; without -> 8), today's-format ModelConfig/args dicts restore with defaults, check_cascade_config accepts today's pair, Trainer mismatch error. Then one e2e local overfit-synthetic deform run at level 4 with NARROW args, --gradient-checkpointing full --lean-sampler true --lean-losses true --split-group-conv true --lambda-ncc-template 1 --lambda-ncc-pair 1 --gpu-memory-limit-mb 6000, followed by tests/gpu/check_mixed_run.py on its run dir (options as used in tests/test_check_mixed_run.py); delete the run dir afterwards.

Plan item 8: new tests/test_integration_steps.py (tests.tf_setup first; also script mode `python -m tests.test_integration_steps --max-v 8 --out <json>`): level-4 (sigma 3) and level-1 (sigma 6) grids, T 6/7, max|v| 2/4/8, max+mean inverse error both orders with interior margin ceil(max|u|)+3, folding_fraction; assert only level 4 / max 2 / T 7: max < 0.1, mean < 0.01; t6_accuracy_ok rule of design 3.6; JSON {t6_accuracy_ok, cases, criteria}; code default --out $BGR_SCRATCH/m9/ else repo scratch/m9/, but local runs pass --out .agents/tasks/milestone-9/integration_steps.json (repo scratch/ is not git-ignored).
Run py_compile + ast feature_version=(3,8) in bgr_preproc38 on every new/changed .py, then the verification commands below.
acceptance_criteria: AC3: tests/test_checkpointing.py cases (a)-(f) pass (gradient equality fp32+AMP <= 1e-4 rel, BN exactly-once, frozen stats, recalibrate_bn one update, one trace per task, same variables).
AC4: tests/test_lean_sampler.py, tests/test_lean_losses.py, tests/test_split_group_conv.py pass, including the graph-mode memory cases A/B/C bounds, and each knob's default-off path is bit-identical.
AC5 (part): parser tests for every new flag's invalid values and the width positivity checks pass.
AC2: a today's-format config.json / ModelConfig dict restores with defaults; check_cascade_config accepts today's level-4 -> level-2 pair.
R2.5: TestLinearOnlyUnchanged and TestDeformUnchanged print max |diff| 0 with all defaults.

AC9 (part): tests/test_integration_steps.py prints max/mean inverse error (both orders) and folding for level-4 and level-1 grids at max|v| 2/4/8, T 6/7, and its script mode writes the t6_accuracy_ok JSON.
The e2e main.py overfit-synthetic run with all knobs on exits 0 and check_mixed_run.py passes.
All new/changed .py files pass py_compile and ast feature_version=(3,8) in bgr_preproc38.
verification: tf_gpu (stage-2 exports): python -m unittest tests.test_width_presets tests.test_width_presets_tf tests.test_diffeo tests.test_checkpointing tests.test_lean_sampler tests.test_lean_losses tests.test_split_group_conv tests.test_integration_steps tests.test_group_layers tests.test_group_net tests.test_spatial_transformer tests.test_runtime_losses_metrics tests.test_main tests.test_runtime_infra -v  -> all OK

tf_gpu: python -m unittest tests.test_cascade -v -> OK (FrozenStage, PREV_LEVEL unchanged)
bgr_preproc38: python -m unittest tests.test_width_presets -v -> OK without importing tensorflow; py_compile + ast (3,8) over all new/changed .py files -> OK

findings: ALL FEAT-001 verification commands pass (local GTX 1080, 6000 MB cap, TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0). Not committed (per instructions). FILES new: models/width_presets.py, models/checkpointing.py, tests/field_helpers.py, tests/test_width_presets.py, tests/test_width_presets_tf.py, tests/test_checkpointing.py, tests/test_lean_sampler.py, tests/test_lean_losses.py, tests/test_split_group_conv.py, tests/test_integration_steps.py; changed: models/config.py, models/layers.py, models/group_net.py, models/diffeo.py, runtime/args.py, runtime/run.py, runtime/losses.py, main.py, tests/test_diffeo.py, tests/test_main.py, tests/test_runtime_infra.py; local output .agents/tasks/milestone-9/integration_steps.json. GOLDENS: '[golden] max |diff| 0 (tolerance 0)' and '[golden deform] max |diff| 0 (tolerance 0)' (goldens 120 s); tests.test_cascade OK (1995 s). LEAN SAMPLER: control-dependency chain used (NO while_loop fallback). test_graph_mode_memory (level-2 field 80x112x96, N 2, Grappler on, peak minus inputs, GiB; two runs): A one-hot warp C19 lean 0.368/0.375 (model 936 B = 1.500, bound 2.249), default 0.413; B integrator T7 lean 0.516/0.516 (model 516 B = 0.827, bound 1.240), default 2.439/2.458 (model 1546 B = 2.477), saving 1.92/1.94 (predicted 1.65, floor 0.85); B lean with _DY_DEP=False 1.137/1.118 (so Grappler dedup IS observed in TF 2.10: without the dy dependency the lean block keeps ~0.6 GiB more); C1 backward C19 zero no images grad 0.256/0.250 (model 240 B = 0.385, bound 0.58); C2 backward C3 border images grad 0.211/0.218 (model 172 B = 0.276, bound 0.41). Note for the memory model: measured lean case A (0.37 GiB) and even default case A (0.41) are far below the modelled forward moment 936 B (1.50 GiB) in this isolated call, i.e. the Fw moment model is conservative here. Lean forward max|diff| 0 eager (zero/border, fill 0/0.3, C 1/3/19, fp32/fp64, fp16 volume) and in tf.function under _GrapplerOff+_OpDeterminism; gradient worst rel fp32 coords 8.6e-8 / images 7.4e-8, fp64 1.6e-16; lean_images_grad False -> None images grad, identical d coords; exp_and_inverse lean forward bitwise equal, grad rel 2.4e-7. CHECKPOINTING full: (a) gradients full vs none bitwise equal (rel 0) fp32 AND AMP with _GrapplerOff+_OpDeterminism (with Grappler ON the AMP graphs alone differed by 4.7e-4 rel, so the test runs Grappler off; documented in the test docstring); (b) BN stats after one Trainer step full vs none rel 0, 'both' encoder 0 / decoder 7.8e-3 (double update kept); (b') persistent tape 2 gradients -> stats == one forward (rel 0); (c) frozen unchanged; (d) recalibrate_bn under full: 2 updates per layer for 2 batches, exact average; (e) trace_counts {rigid 1, affine 1, deform 1} over 6 steps; (f) same variables. recompute() got an extra kwarg training (trace-time restore rule) beyond design signature recompute(fn, bn_layers=()). LEAN LOSSES: worst rel terms 0.0, gradient 2.7e-7 (all lean_sampler x lean_losses combos, Dice+LNCC 1/1); explicit-False call bitwise equal to default under _OpDeterminism. SPLIT: block level (stride 1, 2) fp32 outputs <= 1e-6 and grads <= 1e-4, fp16 block 4.6e-4; DEVIATION: model-level checks use TINY config with outputs at 10x block tolerance (fp32 7.0e-7 measured, bound 1e-5; AMP 1.05e-3, bound 1e-2) and gradients 1.7e-6 (bound 1e-4). With the NARROW config the model-level fp32 gradient differed deterministically by 1.43e-4 (ill-conditioning of the wider linear decoder with training-mode normalisation over N 3, TINY 1.7e-6; split is exact algebra) and outputs 1.0e-6/1.4e-6, so the model-level test was moved to TINY; documented in the test docstring. Stem keeps split False; set_split_group_conv counts 14 blocks on narrow; copy_weights_from split<->non-split OK. WIDTH PRESETS: count_params equals built trainable counts exactly for all 7 presets + narrow/tiny/residual-B (default 29.6286 M, f0d1 29.5372 M, u075 22.1732, u050 16.8183, u0375 14.9952, fr50 29.1430, fr25 28.9558; parts default encoder 9.85 / linear 12.64 / deform 7.14 M). count_params(model_config, deform_decoder=None) accepts ModelConfig, kwargs dict or preset name; preset_args returns ['--filters', '...', '--decoder-widths', '...'].
